title: LADM LA_Right
description: A right is a legally recognised interest in land (e.g. ownership, lease, usufruct, superficies). LA_Right extends LA_RRR with rrrType fixed to 'right' and a type codelist referencing LA_RightType values.

type.description: LA_RightType codelist. Common values: ownership, lease, usufruct, superficies, habitationRight. Recommended scheme: LADM LA_RightType or national equivalent.
